The Bucharest Market Paradox 2026

In Bucharest, RESALE apartments (€2,653/sqm) are 27% MORE EXPENSIVE than NEW ones (€2,099/sqm) — a phenomenon unique to Romania and rare in Europe.

The cause: 21% VAT on new homes (August 2025) redirected demand toward the resale market. Older apartments in central, metro-connected areas now command a structural premium over new developments on the outskirts.

Sources: Storia/OLX Mar 2026 · Imobiliare.ro · Crosspoint/Savills · Compiled by Cristian Văduva — cristianvaduva.com
